_comment: This IAM role is assumed by Snowflake to read/write your S3 bucket.
It is NOT the agents IAM user — it is a separate role for the Snowflake storage integration.
Step 1: Create this role in AWS (replace placeholders).
Step 2: Run CREATE STORAGE INTEGRATION in Snowflake (see stage-setup.sql).
Step 3: Run DESC INTEGRATION in Snowflake — get STORAGE_AWS_IAM_USER_ARN and STORAGE_AWS_EXTERNAL_ID.
Step 4: Update the trust policy below with those values and update the role.
